title: Eventarc and events coming from the platform itself

videos.script: Lesson 17 wired a topic to a function by hand. Eventarc does that wiring for every source Google has. {{triggers}} A trigger answers three questions. Which events, where they go, and as whom. Between them sits a Pub/Sub topic that Eventarc makes for you. {{storage}} Then a real chain on your laptop. A photo lands in a bucket, the bucket announces it, and a function hears about it. Two emulators stand in for Google, and the format is Google's own. {{audit}} Some services announce nothing. For those, Eventarc reads the audit log, which is the widest net and the slowest one. {{retries}} Last, the part that bites. Events arrive at least once. You will watch one message delivered ten times in ten seconds, and learn the three defences against it.
